Public Sub RemoveCommandMgr()
    Try
        iBmp.Dispose()
        iCmdMgr.RemoveCommandGroup(mainCmdGroupID)
        iCmdMgr.RemoveFlyoutGroup(flyoutGroupID)
    Catch e As Exception
    End Try
End Sub
